'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Tom H DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom H]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Same as last year. Tom H (no surname on either sheet), 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2010 form. Unread reserve lines: 55, 57.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
